scope: Existing local replay CLI regular-file, size and error boundaries only

before_fix.unwritten_fifo: All three replay CLIs reached ETIMEDOUT under1500ms harness guards
before_fix.signal_cli_redaction_regression: Failed: OS/parser error message exposed local path or malformed input sentinel

fix: Reuse bounded read-only nonblocking open/fstat/read approach with a shared2MiB file reader for three existing replay CLIs. Signal CLI keeps stable uppercase validator codes but redacts OS/parser messages. No validator calculation, Signal math, quality ceiling, date/as-of or successful output changes. Existing symbolic-link behavior retained.

technical_limit.basis: Same local public JSON byte budget used by existing summarize-public-input CLI; file resource bound, not a financial or operational time policy

new_cases: Three unwritten FIFOs rejected without waiting
Normal V3 and Signal files equal direct existing validator results; unavailable stock buckets remain WAITING_FOR_LIVE_DATA
